cores.description: Number of virtual CPU cores allocated to the VM

sockets.description: Number of virtual CPU sockets (affects NUMA layout and CPU allocation)

ostype.description: Guest operating system type identifier (e.g., l26 for Linux 2.6+)

scsihw.description: SCSI controller model used for disk devices (e.g., virtio-scsi-single)

boot_order.description: Boot sequence specifying which device(s) to attempt booting from first

onboot.description: Whether the VM should start automatically on host boot (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)

agent.description: Whether the QEMU guest agent is enabled for enhanced VM management (1 = enabled, 0 = disabled)
